blockers.detail: 10,109 quantitative records need unit/period/rank/step/base-status normalization; zero were normalized.
Same-city, same-cycle safety/non-safety unit matching has not been constructed for these records.
Temporal ordering, confounding strategy, and design diagnostics are incomplete.
The 49-state corpus is broad but convenience-sourced and uneven; it is not a population sample.
State, region, source-family, and exact-CBA composition are uneven.
5,080 dashboard records are weak, context-only, or unsupported and remain separated.
